entries.49b52e867ed67c6f: A company that operates UGC services such as "Hatena Bookmark" and "Hatena Blog," and also provides development support and marketing support for businesses.
entries.662b0b89066e6bea: This segment provides UGC services that allow users to publish and spread content. The company operates services including “Hatena Bookmark”, which lets users register and share web pages, and “Hatena Blog”, which can be set up for free, and the number of registered users was 13.28 million as of July 2026. The company earns revenue from paid-plan subscription fees, commissions from paid sales of articles, and affiliate advertising revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥319 million.

entries.9ad5d5cb4bb4c1ba: This is the company's only segment, in which it develops and operates in-house UGC services that allow users to publish and share content such as text and images. Drawing on the foundation, technological capabilities and monetization capabilities built through its own services, it offers content platform services for individuals, as well as content marketing services and technology solutions services for businesses. Revenue for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥3,647 million.

entries.dd69ad265c82b93f: This segment supports the service development of client companies by drawing on the development capabilities, IT infrastructure construction capabilities and large-scale data analysis capabilities cultivated through the development and operation of UGC services. The manga viewer “GigaViewer” has been adopted by publishers including Shueisha Inc.’s “Shonen Jump+”, and the company also co-develops KADOKAWA Corporation’s novel posting site “Kakuyomu” and develops game-linked services for Nintendo Co., Ltd. The company also provides “Mackerel”, an observability platform that monitors servers and applications. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥2,780 million.
entries.deb046aaecc1d37a: This segment participates as a co-operator (validator) of the public blockchain “Japan Open Chain” and receives tokens as consideration for validation work. The company joined as a co-operator in October 2024. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥5 million.
entries.e33c8c8c98d800d3: This segment supports companies in building and operating owned media. The company provides “Hatena CMS”, a website content management system, plans and produces content, and supports customer acquisition using advertising space on “Hatena Bookmark” and other services. The company also provides “toitta”, a speech analysis solution using generative AI. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥541 million.
